title: Leg (tour de jeu) — v3.0.0, spec 006-game-scoreboard (supersedes v2.0.0 of spec 005)
description: Each leg is persisted as its own JSON file named leg-{NNN}-{playerSlug}.json inside the atelier folder. v3 (spec 006): ADDITIVE extension of v2 — five new optional fields carry the tour context and the points earned on this leg: turnIndex, majorSuit, suitId, cardValue, points. All are absent on legacy v1/v2 files and read as null/0 (FR-017). The 5 original v2 top-level fields (cardName, scenario, explanation, entries, validation) are unchanged. v1 legacy read (precisions -> entries conversion, author "inconnu") still works. cardName is a REAL card id (e.g. VE2) referencing a Card in atelier.json's deck.

cardName.description: Real id of the played card, e.g. VE2 — references a Card in atelier.json deck

scenario.description: Threat scenario evoked by the player, built from the card's real description

explanation.description: The player's explanation of the scenario

entries.description: Structured entries of the turn (v2, unchanged): precisions and questions WITH their knows/answer. Empty when the card is first played.

validation.description: PENDING when written, then VALIDATED iff strictly more than half of the voters answered yes, else REJECTED

turnIndex.description: NEW v3 — 1-based index of the tour (trick) this leg belongs to; 0 on legacy reads (field was absent). Always serialized by the backend (primitive int).

majorSuit.description: NEW v3 — suitId of the tour's couleur majeure (e.g. "VE"). null when the tour had no non-WC card or on legacy files.

suitId.description: NEW v3 — family (suitId) of the played card. "WC" for the Cornucopia/Wild Card joker. null on legacy files.

cardValue.description: NEW v3 — value of the played card ("2".."10", "J", "Q", "K", "A"), used for the tour bonus comparison. null on legacy files.

points.description: NEW v3 — points earned on this leg: 1 if VALIDATED and the card is in the major suit (WC counts as major suit), plus 1 if this leg also won the tour bonus. 0 otherwise, and 0 on legacy reads. Always serialized (primitive int).

kind.description: PRECISION = added remark; QUESTION = question to the card player, carrying knows/answer

author.description: Player who added the entry; "inconnu" for legacy-converted precisions

text.description: Precision text, or the question text

knows.description: QUESTION only — did the card player answer « Je sais » (true) or « Je sais pas » (false)

answer.description: QUESTION only, present iff knows=true — the « Je sais » answer
